//: MODULE-SYSTEM BOUNDARY — not a real package, and deliberately not a workspace.
//1: Every harness under artifacts/experiments/ is archived spike code written as
//2: CommonJS (require/module.exports). They pre-date the product workspace and are
//3: kept byte-stable as evidence: their recorded results are only reproducible if the
//4: code that produced them is not edited.
//5: The root package.json declares "type": "module" for the product code, and Node
//6: resolves .js module type from the NEAREST package.json. Without this file the root
//7: declaration would reach down here and reclassify all of them as ESM, so every
//8: require() would throw — including the B-02 false-green regression guard, which is
//9: the standing enforcement for Invariant E. This pins them back to CommonJS.
name: pratibimb-experiment-archive
